headline: U.S. Goods Trade Deficit Widens in October on Record AI-Led Imports
summary: The U.S. goods trade deficit widened past 10% in October, driven by record AI-led imports, putting trade on track to weigh on fourth-quarter GDP growth.
why: International trade balances directly influence national GDP calculations, currency valuations, and domestic manufacturing demand.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: A widening trade deficit puts negative pressure on fourth-quarter GDP growth.
